subject: English
question_text: Choose the best answer from the alternatives : 17=7
stimulus: Meherjan lives in a slum on the Sirajgonj Town Protection Embankment. Her polythene-roofed shelter looks like a cage. She is nearly 45 but looks more than her age. In front of her shelter, she is trying to make a fire to cook the day’s only meal. Her weak hands tremble as she add some fallen leaves and straw to the fire. The whispering wind from the river Jamuna makes the fire unsteady. The dancing of the flames reminds Meherjan of the turmoil in her life. Not long ago Meherjan had everything− a family, cultivable land and cattle. The erosion of the Jamuna consumed all her landed property gradually. It finally claimed her only shelter during the last monsoon. It took the river only a day to demolish Meher’s house, trees, vegetable garden and the bamboo bush. She had a happy family once. Over the years, she lost her husband and her family to diseases that cruel hunger and poverty brought to the family. Now, she is the only one left to live on with the loss and the pain. The greedy Jamuna has shattered her dreams and happiness. There are thousand others waiting to share the same fate with Meherjan. Bangladesh is a land of rivers that affect its people. Erosion is a harsh reality for the people living along the river banks. During each monsoon many more villages are threatened by the roaring rivers like the Jamuna, the Padma and the Meghna. It is estimated that river erosion makes at least 100,000 people homeless every year in Bangladesh. In fact, river erosion is one of the main dangers caused by climate change. If we can’t take prompt actions to adapt to climate 2. change, there will be thousands of more Meherjans in our towns and villages every year. (i) destroyed (ii) boosted (iii) flourished (iv) mixed (j) Every year river erosion makes peoples—. (i) poor (ii) rich (iii) homeless (iv) happy (k) Meherjan looks aged because of—. (i) maltreatment (ii) sadness (iii) her age (iv) illness (l) The word 'Tremble' means ⎯ (i) hurdle (ii) quiver (iii) replace (iv) visionary (m) 'Consumed' means ⎯ (i) utilized (ii) devoured (iii) ravaged (iv) spoiled (n) The word 'shattered' means ⎯ (i) confronted (ii) faced (iii) devastated (iv) magnified Give short answer to the following questions. 25=10 (a) Where does Meherjan live now? (b) Is Meherjan a pathetic character? Why/Why not? (c) Why do her hands tremble? (d) What happened to her family members? (e) Why were her dreams shattered? Extra Questions : (f) What is river erosion? (g) What do you mean by adaptation? (h) What is climate change? (i) What does the dancing flame remind Meherjan? (j) How do you feel for Meherjan? (k) Why does she look more than her age? (l) What should we do to save our Meherjans? (m) Can you justify why river erosion is one of the greatest threats to us? (n) How can we stop river erosion?
